Policy: After a genuine completed customer interaction; send one neutral request to all eligible customers through an owned channel.
Never offer gifts, discounts or benefits for a review or positive sentiment.
Do not ask only happy customers to post publicly or suppress negative feedback.
Assign an owner to check public reviews regularly and escalate safety/privacy/legal issues through appropriate processes.
Do not disclose order details or personal information in public replies; move account specifics to a private support channel.
Do not write, buy, fabricate, or ask staff/family to pose as customers.
